issues.body:
Canonical task: [T01](https://github.com/nSealr/nsealr/blob/main/docs/restart/work-items.json). This issue is navigation and bounded source findings, not a second lifecycle ledger.

The source at nsealr `3cbd818a0bcd4016eb8983dad7605cb57280d913` has twelve universal booleans in `crates/nsealr-core/src/policy/signing_policy.rs`; `protocol.rs` still emits scaffold readiness and keeps signing disabled. Companion `678796900e462f5504e47fe934e2e5f23d85824f` has a fixed capability method list and inherited limits in `packages/protocol`, while `packages/policy/src/policy.ts` requires persistent grants for connected routes. Those requirements must not silently become the new manual-consent contract.

Prepare an exact specification before implementation: distinguish supported/configured/verified/unavailable/unknown, explicit no-SE versus missing required SE, methods/algorithms/custody/transport and finite measured limits; device claims are not evidence or attestation. Keep NIP-44 primitives, verified message context and an admitted NIP-17/59 workflow distinct. Initial offline profiles do not gain message or persistent-grant support by fallback. Local authority is owned by S03/K01 and physical device gates, never by a host manifest.

Reconcile with the accepted P01 requirements and final A02 contract/loader layout. Record a version/consumer transition with independent positive/negative vectors; there is no obligation to preserve experimental APIs. Board SDK remains Nostr-independent. No new profile is qualified by a schema or a successful flag.
issues.title: T01: replace universal readiness flags with per-profile contracts

issues.body:
Canonical task: [H01](https://github.com/nSealr/nsealr/blob/main/docs/restart/work-items.json). This issue locates research; current state and acceptance remain in that graph.

Prepare a source-backed manual/register brief against accepted P01 and actual `nSealr/hardware` source `340697d6713a671e9e01b0dc874ec999ab071601`. Review exact MCU/package/silicon candidates, SE commands/errata/access, display/input ownership, USB/power/battery and maker expansion boundaries. Compare viable options; do not inherit the old PCB/BOM as selected design or extrapolate Safe 7's MCU/display onto another part.

Each substantive claim needs an official exact revision/section and retrieved hash where available. Preserve retrieval failures and restricted-document gaps. A link inventory is not a manual review. Separate completed host-relevant feasibility review from mandatory selected-design/SE work that must close before H02S/H04. No ordering, part freeze, PCB layout, physical measurements or silicon remediation is implied.

Reuse existing reviewed research only after exact source/delta correspondence; independently verify the remaining relevant manual sections. TROPIC development boards and wallet references are investigation inputs, with their original licensing and declared security limits preserved. H01 does not impose an SE-document or custom-board dependency on unrelated ESP32/Pi/P4 software.
issues.title: H01: review component manuals and viable board alternatives
